tasks.detail: Analyse this repo and serve the browser UI
tasks.label: Mezzanine: Start web UI

tasks.detail: Opens http://localhost:3000, starting the engine first
tasks.label: Mezzanine: Open web UI in browser

tasks.command: PORT=3000; if [ -z "$(lsof -ti tcp:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN)" ]; then echo "No process is listening on port $PORT — nothing to stop."; else for p in $(lsof -ti tcp:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN); do CMD=$(ps -o comm= -p $p); if [ "$(basename "$CMD")" = "mezz" ]; then kill $p && echo "Stopped mezz engine on port $PORT (pid $p)."; else echo "Port $PORT is held by pid $p ($CMD), which is not mezz — left alone."; fi; done; fi
tasks.detail: Kills the engine holding this repo's port. Closing the browser does not stop it.
tasks.label: Mezzanine: Stop web UI
